## B4 — M5-2 · The Stack ⇄ Backend Studio

> **direct:** M5-2 is the S-stack — the system's working body. **S0**: a kernel written in C, computing the system's core mathematics in real time — archetypal bio-quaternions: changes in a person's symbolic and elemental reading modelled as rotations in four-dimensional space, clocked to astrological time, the planets' actual positions. **S1**: the vault — the written corpus under compiler law, every link protected. **S2**: the graph — the Bimba map as one queryable body of knowledge. **S3**: the gateway — sessions, cron-jobs, shared-time, messaging channels; the live wire between substrate and surface. **S4**: the agent runtime. **S5**: the learning layer — itself the system's most complex agent: a verification intelligence in the JEPA / energy-based family, learning from every run, review, and return, so the system's judgment deepens with use. In form we're building an agent harness, kin to Hermes or OpenClaw, calling the same models. The difference is the gesture. Most harnesses serve the isolated individual — agents as hired hands for one user's tasks. This one is built toward a culture: a field in which any person shows up in a mathematically meaningful, unique way relative to the symbolic systems of humanity, and AI agents act as harmonious partners rather than tools.
>
> **prime:** M5-2′ is the Backend Studio: the whole stack inspectable and agent-editable through governed tasks, tests, and evidence. The claim can fail here, publicly — which is exactly what makes it more than literature.
>
> **substrate:** S0 epi-lib C kernel · portal-core Rust mirror · epi-cli / S1 Hen compiler — vault law · S2 graph-schema + graph-services / S3 gateway · graphiti-runtime · redis-context / S4 pi-agent + ta-onta · S5 verification/learning cores — review · autoresearch · gnostic
